set -eu
root=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR="/run/user/$(id -u)"
export DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS="unix:path=$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/bus"
test -f "$root/deploy/secrets/userbot_verify.session"
systemctl --user is-active --quiet gace-userbot-verify.service
systemctl --user stop gace-userbot-verify.service
trap 'systemctl --user start gace-userbot-verify.service || true' EXIT
cd "$root"
deploy/.userbot-venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
import asyncio
from telethon import TelegramClient
from scripts.userbot_session import load_credentials, SESSION_BASE
async def main():
    api_id,api_hash=load_credentials()
    async with TelegramClient(str(SESSION_BASE),api_id,api_hash,auto_reconnect=True) as c:
        if not await c.is_user_authorized():
            raise RuntimeError("SESSION_NOT_AUTHORIZED")
        bot=await c.get_entity("GayBBS_bot")
        print("USERBOT_AUTHORIZED_PASS")
        print("TARGET_IS_BOT="+str(bool(bot.bot)))
        before=(await c.get_messages(bot,limit=1))
        cursor=before[0].id if before else 0
        await c.send_message(bot,"/start")
        for _ in range(12):
            await asyncio.sleep(1)
            msgs=await c.get_messages(bot,limit=8)
            replies=[m for m in msgs if m.id>cursor and not m.out]
            if replies:break
        else:raise RuntimeError("START_RESPONSE_NOT_RECEIVED")
        latest=sorted(replies,key=lambda m:m.id)[-1]
        buttons=[b.text for row in (latest.buttons or []) for b in row]
        print("BOT_START_RESPONSE_PASS")
        print("BOT_START_BUTTON_COUNT="+str(len(buttons)))
        print("BOT_START_BUTTON_LABELS="+",".join(buttons))
asyncio.run(main())
PY
echo USERBOT_REAL_START_SMOKE_DONE
